timeline.title: Register interest
timeline.text: Get in touch with Dr Peter Bratby to register interest or ask questions. Open to NatSci students in years 1 to 4.

timeline.title: Launch session
timeline.text: Meet other students, share ideas and form small teams around a project of your own design.

timeline.title: Run your project
timeline.text: Teams work independently on their project, in any area of Natural Sciences. You don't need to be in London.

timeline.title: Student showcase
timeline.text: Teams present their results to students and staff at the showcase.

timeline.title: Awards and gallery
timeline.text: Best Project and Student Choice are announced, and every project joins the gallery.

projects.title: Machine Learning for Exoplanet Detection
projects.abstract: A deep neural network trained on NASA Kepler Space Telescope data to distinguish confirmed exoplanets from false positives, with the aim of laying groundwork for further work in automated detection.

projects.title: Mapping Urban Heat Islands Across Greater London
projects.abstract: Satellite thermal imaging combined with ground sensor readings to identify where London heats fastest, and how green space correlates with local temperature.

projects.title: A Low-Cost Spectrometer from Consumer Optics
projects.abstract: Building and calibrating a working spectrometer from a webcam sensor and a diffraction grating, tested against known emission spectra.

projects.title: Modelling Antibiotic Resistance in Mixed Bacterial Populations
projects.abstract: An agent-based simulation of how resistance spreads under different dosing schedules, compared against published clinical data.

projects.title: Catalyst Screening for Plastic Depolymerisation
projects.abstract: A comparison of low-temperature catalysts for breaking down PET, run as a small-scale bench study over eight weeks.

projects.title: Predicting Protein Fold Stability from Sequence Alone
projects.abstract: A lightweight model trained on public mutation data to estimate how single amino acid substitutions affect folding stability, benchmarked against experimental melting temperatures.

projects.title: Sonifying Seismic Data from the British Isles
projects.abstract: Converting a decade of low-magnitude UK earthquake recordings into audio, and testing whether listeners can identify event depth by ear more reliably than by reading a seismogram.

projects.title: Electrochemical Detection of Microplastics in Tap Water
projects.abstract: A prototype sensor using modified carbon electrodes to flag polymer particles in water samples collected from six London boroughs.

projects.title: The Geometry of Soap Films on Wire Frames
projects.abstract: An experimental and computational study of minimal surfaces, comparing photographed soap films against numerically solved Plateau problems.

projects.title: Modelling Vaccine Rollout Under Supply Constraints
projects.abstract: A compartmental model exploring how different prioritisation strategies change outcomes when doses arrive unevenly over time.

projects.title: Building a Cloud Chamber from Household Materials
projects.abstract: A step-by-step build and characterisation of a diffusion cloud chamber, including measured track counts at different altitudes around London.

projects.title: Green Solvent Alternatives for Undergraduate Teaching Labs
projects.abstract: A survey of safer replacements for common teaching lab solvents, assessed on cost, yield and waste handling.

projects.title: Air Quality During Lockdown: A London Case Study
projects.abstract: Analysis of nitrogen dioxide and particulate readings from public monitoring stations before, during and after the first UK lockdown.

projects.title: A Browser-Based Simulator for Cellular Automata
projects.abstract: An interactive tool for exploring rule spaces in one and two dimensions, built for use in first-year teaching.

projects.title: Bioluminescence in Cultured Algae
projects.abstract: Measuring how light output in dinoflagellate cultures varies with the timing of mechanical stimulation across a simulated day-night cycle.
